sentences.text: Variation is the angle between true north and magnetic north at your location.
It’s the same no matter which way the boat is heading.
Read it from the center of the nearest compass rose on your chart, which also gives the year it was measured and the annual change.
Multiply the annual change by the number of years since then, and apply it.
In Florida, variation is a few degrees west, from roughly two degrees in the western Panhandle to around eight degrees on the Atlantic coast, and it changes slowly over time.
Westerly variation means magnetic north lies to the west of true north.
